blocks.title: Legacy Essentials
blocks.tagline: Autosave, controller fix, login fix, volume and window mode in a small menu for TrackMania Nations ESWC, Sunrise and Original.

items.title: Replays on their own
items.text: Every finish is saved as a normal .Replay.Gbx, without clicking Save replay. Best times only, or every finish.

items.title: Controller fix
items.text: A pad plugged in or switched on mid-race works at once, with the game's own bindings for it.

items.title: Online login fixed
items.text: ESWC and Original: the login works again on Windows 10 and 11 (error 12157). For the game process only.

items.title: Small menu
items.text: Ctrl+F2: volume, music, sounds and window mode, each part on or off, the replay folder. Settings stay in the ini.

items.title: TMX copy
items.text: ESWC servers: a second file keeps only your ghost and inputs, ready for TMX.

items.title: Fits the Horizon Client
items.text: With the Horizon Client it steps aside for the client's login fix, controller fix, game settings and menu.

blocks.title: Requirements
blocks.markdown: It works with **these exes only**: the unofficial community patch of **TrackMania Nations ESWC 1.80** (`TmNationsESWC.exe`, in-game version 0.1.7.9), the **TrackMania Sunrise** Win10 community repack (`TmSunrise.exe`) and **TrackMania Original** with the Online Patch v2 exe (`TMORIGINAL.EXE`). With any other exe the mod does nothing and says so in its log.

rows.note: Online Patch v2 exe; autosave solo only

items.a: Into GameData\Tracks\Replays\My Replays, named after the track and the time. Existing files are never overwritten. The menu's Open folder button opens it.

items.q: There is no eswc_autosave.log after starting the game.
items.a: Then eswc_autosave.dll is missing or could not be loaded, and the game runs without the mod. Copy dinput8.dll, eswc_autosave.dll and eswc_autosave.ini next to the game exe.

items.q: Another mod already has a dinput8.dll.
items.a: Rename that one to dinput8.chain.dll, then copy the three files. Legacy Essentials passes DirectInput on to it.
Rename Legacy Essentials' dinput8.dll to dinput8.chain.dll next to the client's dinput8.dll. The client then runs the login fix, controller fix and menu; Legacy Essentials keeps the autosave.

It sends no input and changes no physics. The login fix allows TLS 1.0 and skips the revocation check for the game process only; use a password for your ESWC account that you do not use anywhere else.
